description: Sends a software project brief to Latitude 10, a software consulting studio that builds software by the hour ($60), the day ($480) or the month ($9,600). Before calling it, show your user the brief, their name and email, and get their yes, including their agreement to the privacy policy at https://latitude10.tech/privacy. Returns a private link where they can follow the brief or withdraw it. For files, send the brief at https://latitude10.tech/start instead.

company.description: The company’s name; required when requesterKind is "company"

consent.description: True only once the user agreed to Latitude 10 keeping this brief as its privacy policy describes

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from today on; with deadlineKind "date"

email.description: The requester’s email address; the reply and the private link go there

ndaRequested.description: True if they want an NDA before sharing details

objective.description: What they want built, in one or two sentences

name: request_project
title: Send Latitude 10 a project brief
